scripts.text:
DECLARE @rundate DATE
DECLARE @ReportRunDate DATE
DECLARE @date CHAR(8)
DECLARE @time CHAR(4)
DECLARE @seconds CHAR(2)
DECLARE @milliseconds CHAR(3)
DECLARE @STARTTIME CHAR(8)
DECLARE @adhocrun VARCHAR(2)
DECLARE @ID INT
DECLARE @MarketID INT
DECLARE @MarketName VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @MarketShortName VARCHAR(20)
DECLARE @Status VARCHAR(30)
DECLARE @LastAdhocRun VARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @LastFileName VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @LastFileRerunDate DATETIME
DECLARE @MarketComplete VARCHAR(2)

DECLARE @In_MarketShortName VARCHAR(20)
DECLARE @In_ReportRunDate DATE

SET @In_MarketShortName = @0
SET @In_ReportRunDate = @1

SET @time = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE())), 2) + RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(MINUTE, GETDATE())), 2)

SET @seconds = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(SECOND, GETDATE())), 2)

SET @milliseconds = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3), DATEPART(MILLISECOND, GETDATE())), 3)

SET @STARTTIME = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE())), 2) + ':'+ RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(MINUTE, GETDATE())), 2) + ':' +
						RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(SECOND, GETDATE())), 2)

SELECT TOP 1 @ID = [ID],
	@MarketID = [MarketID],
	@MarketName = [MarketName],
	@MarketShortName = [MarketShortName],
	@ReportRunDate = [ReportRunDate],
	@LastAdhocRun = [AdhocRun], 
	@Status = [Status],
                @LastFileName = [FileName],
	@LastFileRerunDate = [FileRerunDate]
FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
WHERE [MarketShortName] = @In_MarketShortName
	AND [ActualRunDate] <= CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
ORDER BY ID DESC

--SELECT @ID,@MarketName,@MarketShortName,@Status

WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02'

--No Prior Runs
IF (@Status IS NULL)
BEGIN
	IF (@In_ReportRunDate = '01/01/1900')
	BEGIN
		SET @ID = '1'

		SET @ReportRunDate =  '01/01/1900'
		
		SET @MarketID = '0'
		
		SET @MarketName = 'Unknown'

		SET @MarketShortName = 'Unknown'

		SET @rundate = GETDATE()

	 	SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'N'
		
		SET @LastAdhocRun  = 'N'

		SET @MarketComplete = 'N'
	END
	ELSE IF (@In_ReportRunDate <> '01/01/1900' AND @In_ReportRunDate <> CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))
	BEGIN
		SET @ReportRunDate = @In_ReportRunDate

		SET @rundate = @In_ReportRunDate
  
		SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'Y'

		SET @MarketComplete = 'N'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @ReportRunDate = GETDATE()

		SET @rundate = GETDATE()
  
		SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'Y'

		SET @MarketComplete = 'Y'
	END
END
--Prior Run Failed
ELSE IF (@Status = 'Failed')
BEGIN
	UPDATE c
	SET FileRerunDate = GETDATE()
	FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] c
	WHERE [ID] = @ID
		AND [MarketShortName] = @MarketShortName
		AND [Status] = 'Failed'
		AND [FileRerun] = 'Y'
		AND [FileRerunDate] IS NULL
		
	WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02'
 
	SELECT @rundate = ReportRunDate, @adhocrun = AdhocRun FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] WHERE [ID] = @ID AND MarketShortName = @MarketShortName

	SELECT @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

	SET @adhocrun = @LastAdhocRun

	SET @MarketComplete = 'N'
END
--Prior Run Completed Successfully
ELSE IF (@Status = 'Completed Successfully' AND @LastFileRerunDate IS NULL)
BEGIN
	IF (@In_ReportRunDate = '01/01/1900')
	BEGIN
		SET @rundate = GETDATE()

	                SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'N'
		
		WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02'
		
		IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName AND FileCompleteType = 'Daily' AND ActualRunDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())) = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @MarketComplete = 'Y'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @MarketComplete = 'N'
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@In_ReportRunDate <> '01/01/1900' AND @In_ReportRunDate <> CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))
	BEGIN
		SET @rundate = @In_ReportRunDate
  
		SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'Y'

		SET @MarketComplete = 'N'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @rundate = GETDATE()
  
		SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)

		SET @adhocrun = 'Y'

		SET @MarketComplete = 'Y'
	END
END
--In-Progress status that did not update correctly
ELSE IF (@Status = 'In-Progress')
BEGIN
	UPDATE c
	SET c.ActualEndTime = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),
		c.Duration = CONVERT(TIME,DATEADD(MS,DATEDIFF(SS, c.ActualStartTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108) )*1000,0),114), 
		c.Status = 'Completed Successfully'
	FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] c
	WHERE [ID] = @ID
		AND [MarketShortName] = @MarketShortName
	
	WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02'
	
	SET @rundate = @ReportRunDate 
  
	SET @date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),@rundate,112)
	
	SET @adhocrun = @LastAdhocRun 

	SET @MarketComplete = 'Y'

	SET @Status = 'Completed Successfully'
END

SELECT @rundate AS [Report_Run_Date],@adhocrun AS [AdhocRun],@date AS [Created_Date],@time AS [Created_Time], @seconds AS [Created_Seconds],@milliseconds AS[created_milliseconds],@MarketComplete AS [MarketComplete],@ID AS [LastLogID], @MarketID AS [LastMarketID], @MarketName AS [LastMarketName],@MarketShortName  AS [LastMarketShortName],@ReportRunDate AS [LastReportRunDate],@Status AS [LastFileRunStatus] ,@LastFileName AS [LastFileName], @LastAdhocRun  AS [LastFileAdhocRun],@STARTTIME AS [STARTTIME]

SELECT DISTINCT MarketID,MarketName,MarketShortName,StoredProcedureName,Frequency,
  FileName = CASE WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.milliseconds%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FILENAMELAYOUT,'YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.milliseconds',@0+'_'+@1+@2+'.'+@3+'_ADHOC'),' ','')
	WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMMSS%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS',@4+@5+@6+'_ADHOC'),' ','') 
                  WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMM%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMM',@7+@8+'_ADHOC'),' ','') 
                  WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDD%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDD',@9+'_ADHOC'),' ','') 
             END
FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Market_Config] 
Where MarketShortName = @10

DECLARE @In_Created_Date VARCHAR(8)
DECLARE @In_Created_Time VARCHAR(4)
DECLARE @In_Created_Seconds VARCHAR(2)
DECLARE @In_Created_MilliSeconds VARCHAR(3)
DECLARE @In_MarketShortName VARCHAR(255)

SET @In_Created_Date = @0
SET @In_Created_Time = @1
SET @In_Created_Seconds = @2
SET @In_Created_MilliSeconds = @3
SET @In_MarketShortName = @4

IF @In_MarketShortName = 'WI'
BEGIN
SET @In_Created_Date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
	SELECT DISTINCT MarketID,MarketName,MarketShortName,StoredProcedureName,Frequency,
			FileName = CASE WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMMSS%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS',@In_Created_Date+@In_Created_Time+@In_Created_Seconds),' ','') 
							WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMM%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMM',@In_Created_Date+@In_Created_Time),' ','') 
							WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDD%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDD',@In_Created_Date),' ','') 
					   END
	FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Market_Config] 
	Where MarketShortName = @In_MarketShortName
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT MarketID,MarketName,MarketShortName,StoredProcedureName,Frequency,
			FileName = CASE WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.milliseconds%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FILENAMELAYOUT,'YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.milliseconds',@In_Created_Date+'_'+@In_Created_Time+@In_Created_Seconds+'.'+@In_Created_MilliSeconds),' ','')
							WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMMSS%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS',@In_Created_Date+@In_Created_Time+@In_Created_Seconds),' ','') 
							WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDDHHMM%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDDHHMM',@In_Created_Date+@In_Created_Time),' ','') 
							WHEN FileNameLayout LIKE '%YYYYMMDD%' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(FileNameLayout,'YYYYMMDD',@In_Created_Date),' ','') 
					   END
	FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Market_Config] 
	Where MarketShortName = @In_MarketShortName
END

SELECT Count(*) AS RECORD_COUNT 
FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
WHERE MarketID = @0
AND FileName = @1

INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] (MarketID,MarketName,MarketShortName,StoredProcedureName,AdhocRun,ReportRunDate,ActualRunDate,ActualStartTime,Status,FileCheck,FileCheckDate,FileRerun)
VALUES (@MarketID,@MarketName,@MarketShortName,@StoredProcedureName,@AdhocRun,@LastReportRunDate,GETDATE(),GETDATE(),'Completed Successfully','Y',GETDATE(),'N')

WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02'

UPDATE c
SET c.ActualEndTime = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),
c.Duration = CONVERT(TIME,DATEADD(MS,DATEDIFF(SS, c.ActualStartTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108) )*1000,0),114), 
c.FileName = @LastFileName,
c.FileLocation = @Archive_Source_Path,
c.FileCompleteType = CASE WHEN @AdhocRun = 'Y' THEN 'Adhoc' ELSE @Frequency END
FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log]  c
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID = MAX(ID),MarketShortName
   FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
   WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName
   GROUP BY MarketShortName) l
on c.MarketShortName = l.MarketShortName
and c.ID = l.ID

UPDATE c
SET c.FileName = @LastFileName,
c.FileLocation = @Archive_Source_Path,
c.FileCompleteType = CASE WHEN @AdhocRun = 'Y' THEN 'Adhoc' ELSE @Frequency END,
c.FileCheck = 'Y',
c.FileCheckDate = GETDATE()
FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log]  c
WHERE ID = @LastLogID

IF (@Report_Run_Date <> CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))
BEGIN
	IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName AND [Status] = 'Failed' AND [FileRerun] = 'Y' AND [FileRerunDate] IS NULL AND [AdhocRun] = 'Y') >= 1
	BEGIN
		UPDATE c
		SET c.AdhocRun = 'Y'
		FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log]  c
		INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID = MAX(ID),MarketShortName
		   FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
		   WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName
		   GROUP BY MarketShortName) l
	on c.MarketShortName = l.MarketShortName
		and c.ID = l.ID
	END
END

UPDATE c
SET c.FileCompleteType = @Frequency,
        c.FileName = @FileName,
        c.FileLocation = @Archive_Source_Path	
FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log]  c
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID = MAX(ID),MarketShortName
   FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
   WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName
   GROUP BY MarketShortName) l
on c.MarketShortName = l.MarketShortName
and c.ID = l.ID

UPDATE c
SET c.ActualEndTime = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),
c.Duration = CONVERT(TIME,DATEADD(MS,DATEDIFF(SS, c.ActualStartTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108) )*1000,0),114),	
c.RecordCount = @Record_Count,
c.Status = 'Completed Successfully'
FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log]  c
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID = MAX(ID),MarketShortName
			FROM  [EXTRACT].[EVV_Prior_Auth_Extract_Log] 
		WHERE MarketShortName = @MarketShortName
		GROUP BY MarketShortName) l
on c.MarketShortName = l.MarketShortName
and c.ID = l.ID
